title.narrative: Building Alliances for Budget Accountability in the Western Balkans

description.narrative: The project aims to increase government responsiveness toward civil society engagement on priority budget and service delivery issues. The two outcomes are: 1/ Improved fiscal transparency, participation, and oversight, and 2/ Enhanced civil society capacity and strategic engagement in budgets and public services. Support to civil society capacity development in all IPA countries; Implementing 2 round of the Open Budget Survey in 6 IPA countries (except Kosovo).
